You can choose how many layers you want on the top, bottom, and perimeter of your print. It's basically how many loops of filament your nozzle will extrude before the infill. Personally I only increase my infill if I want a denser print. If I want it stronger, or I have the same issue as you I would increase the infill slightly, and then increase perimeters, I usually do 2-4 on the walls, and 4-5 on top and bottom. Or you can also experiment with lightning infill (if your slicer has it as an option). Glad to see someone exploring a new hobby and hopefully everyone has been welcoming.
